description: This file defines the `ContainerException` class, a custom exception class in the OFBiz framework extending `GenericConfigException`. It provides various constructors for error handling related to container configuration or runtime issues.

classes.name: ContainerException
classes.description: A custom exception class used within the OFBiz framework to indicate errors related to container configuration or operation, extending `GenericConfigException`.
